none: PAS BH-ABDC52: Roman coin: incomplete siliqua of Julian (contemporary copy)
contea di ritrovamento: Bedford (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete silver siliqua of Julian, AD 355-363. This coin is a contemporary copy*, made using high quality silver. The obverse, which bears the legend 'D N IVLIAN-VS [P F AVG]', appears to have been copied from a coin of Arles (cf.
